VehicleComments: The 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD Work Truck is a powerful and reliable vehicle that has been driven 83,551 miles. It is equipped with a 6.6 liter V8 401hp 464 lb-ft engine and fuel injected, making it an ideal choice for those looking for a dependable ride. This vehicle also comes with a number of features such as a touch screen display, Bluetooth audio connection, hill start assist, part time four wheel drive, Apple Carplay ready, and Bluetooth phone connectivity. With its combination of power and convenience, the 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD Work Truck is sure to be a great choice for any driver.
